title: Reuse SSTable index cache in Fusion last
rationale: FusionTransaction::last selected SSTable candidate blocks with BTreeMap range lookups and a temporary candidate vector. SsTable already caches sorted index_keys and index_offsets, so last() can use binary search over those cached vectors while still checking the current and previous candidate blocks.
steps: Use cached SSTable index_keys to find the block start immediately before the range end
Use cached index_offsets for current and previous candidate block offsets
Avoid the temporary candidate_blocks Vec allocation
Add a storage test that flushes data to SSTable and calls last() directly
expected_impact: Reduces per-SSTable lookup overhead for MAX/last-style range queries over flushed data.
